plainTranslation: Venus crosses your presence. Charming, attractive, easy to be around; you draw warmth toward you. A lovely window for first impressions, romance, and being liked.
policy: Transit-to-natal entries are ordered: transiting planet to natal point. Do not apply same-moment aspect exclusions. Interpret as an active pressure or opening, not a guaranteed event.
note: Imported from project-authored transit-to-natal matrix material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
